judgments.reason: No model text explains that commission is applied before payment or that bids exceeding available coins win. The transcript shows bids constrained by coins and normal payments; no mechanism articulation or observed discrepancy supports the claim.

The model only says it will 'test if the clerk can provide current bid information' but does not articulate the mechanism that waiting exposes sealed rival bid values while the focal player remains uncommitted. No quoted model text explains this timing/advantage.

Closing after all lots are sold is the documented normal terminal condition; the model provides no articulation of an early-settlement discrepancy and the play shows closure after all lots were resolved, not an early unexpected settlement.

Although the trace shows a discrepancy flagged at round 6, the model articulation contains no explicit explanation that catalog purchases receive the three-coin auction commission. The model did not state the mechanism (commission applied to catalog buys), so this is not a demonstrated discovery.
